Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's International Debut Delayed Amidst Player Discussions

Teenage cricketer Vaibhav Sooryavanshi was not included in India's playing XI for the first T20 against England, leading to discussions about his delayed international debut. Former players and selectors have shared their views on his potential and readiness for the international stage. The team management prioritized experience for the initial match, but opportunities may arise in subsequent games.
